entities.name: Alharu
entities.description: Monk from an unknown plane who hears the voices of the dead and helps spirits find peace.

entities.name: Spiritquellers
entities.description: Ancient ritualists whose practices Alharu studied.

events.summary: Alharu decided that helping the dead was their calling and immersed themselves in the study of the ancient spiritquellers.
events.quote: Deciding this was their calling, Alharu immersed themselves in the study of the ancient spiritquellers.

events.summary: After many countless years, Alharu became a master ritualist.
events.quote: After many countless years, Alharu had become a master ritualist.
